metadata.title: Privacy policy — TinyGenius Hub
metadata.description: Committed to protecting parent and child data on the TinyGenius Hub platform.

privacy.intro: This policy explains how TinyGenius Hub collects, processes, stores and protects parents' personal data and children's learning data when using the platform.

s1.heading: 1. Legal basis of reference
s1.i1: Law on Personal Data Protection No. 91/2025/QH15 (effective from January 1, 2026).
s1.i3: Law on Consumer Rights Protection No. 19/2023/QH15 and related guiding documents.

s2.heading: 2. Data we collect
s2.i1: Parent account data: email, display name, registration status.
s2.i2: Children's learning data: learning records, lesson progress, learning interaction history.
s2.i3: Technical data: IP address, device, access log for system safety.
s2.i4: Payment data: transaction information from payment partners (full card number is not saved).

s3.heading: 3. Purpose of data processing
s3.i1: We process data on one or more appropriate legal bases, such as performance of a contract or legal obligation, consent or legitimate interests under applicable law.
s3.i2: Account operations and core learning functions.
s3.i3: Personalize the learning experience according to the child's age and level.
s3.i4: Send service notifications, progress reports, technical support.
s3.i5: Prevent fraud and abuse and meet legal requirements.

s4.heading: 4. Children's data
s4.i1: Main account created and controlled by parents.
s4.i2: We do not purchase or sell children's personal data for independent commercial purposes.
s4.i3: We do not run behavioral ads aimed directly at children.
s4.i4: Where processing beyond the core learning objectives is required, we require an appropriate lawful basis.

s5.heading: 5. Share data with third parties
s5.i1: Share only to the extent necessary to provide the service.
s5.i2: Key partner groups: infrastructure, email, payments, security and analytics.
s5.i3: Partners must comply with data security obligations under contracts or applicable laws.

s6.heading: 6. Store and protect data
s6.i1: Data is protected using risk-appropriate technical and organizational measures.
s6.i3: The storage period is determined according to the purpose of processing and the legal obligations involved.

s7.heading: 7. Rights of data subjects
s7.i1: Right to know, access, and correct personal data.
s7.i2: The right to request restriction of processing or deletion of data to the extent permitted by law.
s7.i3: Right to withdraw consent for purposes based on consent.
s7.i4: We respond to data subject requests within the time limits prescribed by applicable law.

s8.heading: 8. Cookies and tracking
s8.i1: Necessary cookies are always active to ensure login security.
s8.i2: Analytical/marketing cookies are enabled only with explicit consent.

s9.heading: 9. Cross-border data transfer
s9.body: When there are cross-border transfers of personal data, we implement records and controls according to the legal framework applicable at the time of processing.

terms.intro: These terms stipulate the rights and obligations between users and TinyGenius Hub when using the website, application and related services.

s1.heading: 1. Accept terms
s1.i1: By creating an account or continuing to use the service, you confirm that you have read and agree to these terms.
s1.i2: If you do not agree, please stop accessing and using the service.

s2.heading: 2. Target users
s2.i1: The account holder must be at least 18 years old or as required by applicable law.
s2.i2: Parents are responsible for managing their children's account information and learning activities on the platform.

s3.heading: 3. Service description
s3.i1: The platform provides learning content for children, progress tracking tools, and reporting for parents.
s3.i2: Some features may require a paid service plan or additional terms of use.

s4.heading: 4. Account and security
s4.i1: Users must provide accurate and updated registration information when there are changes.
s4.i2: Users themselves secure their passwords, login devices, and authentication information.
s4.i3: Users need to notify immediately when detecting unauthorized access.

s5.heading: 5. Payment and refund
s5.i1: Service fees, billing cycles and package benefits are announced at the time of transaction.

s6.heading: 6. Intellectual property rights
s6.i1: Learning content, design, source code and brand assets are legally owned by the platform.
s6.i2: Copying, redistribution or commercial exploitation without written consent is strictly prohibited.

s7.heading: 7. Prohibited acts
s7.i1: Unauthorized intrusion, system intervention, spreading malicious code or API abuse.
s7.i2: Collect user data without permission or use data for other purposes.
s7.i3: Impersonate another organization/individual or provide false information.

s9.heading: 9. Limitation of liability
s9.i1: Nothing in this document shall exclude or limit the mandatory rights of consumers.
s9.i2: The limitation of liability only applies to the extent permitted by law.
s9.i3: The Services are provided on a reasonable efforts basis under actual operating conditions.
s9.i4: We are not responsible for indirect/arising damages beyond the scope of reasonable control according to applicable law.

s10.heading: 10. Suspension or termination of service
s10.i1: We may suspend/terminate accounts if we detect violations of terms or legal requirements.
s10.i2: Except in legal/security emergencies, we will notify in advance and provide appropriate complaint channels.
s10.i3: Users may request account termination in accordance with applicable policies.

s11.heading: 11. Update terms
s11.body: Terms may be updated to reflect legal or product changes. Important changes will be announced before applying.

s12.heading: 12. Applicable law and dispute resolution
s12.body: These terms are governed by Vietnamese law. In case of dispute, the parties prioritize negotiation before transferring the matter to the competent authority for resolution according to the law.

metadata.title: Cookie Policy — TinyGenius Hub
metadata.description: Explains how TinyGenius Hub uses necessary, analytical and marketing cookies; how parents manage or withdraw consent.

cookiePolicy.intro: This policy describes how TinyGenius Hub uses cookies when you visit the website/app. We only enable non-essential cookies after explicit consent from parents.

s1.heading: 1. What are cookies?
s1.body: Cookies are small files saved in your browser to identify sessions, remember choices, and measure product performance.

s2.heading: 2. Groups of cookies we use
s2.necessaryDesc: required for sign-in, session continuity, abuse prevention, and system security.
s2.analyticalDesc: measure aggregate usage behavior (for example GA4) to improve the product.
s2.marketingDesc: measure campaign effectiveness (for example Meta Pixel) for parent-facing content.

s3.heading: 3. Principle of consent
s3.i1: We do not default to "all in."
s3.i3: You can withdraw or change your selection at any time.

s4.heading: 4. Manage cookie preferences
s4.body: The cookie panel currently supports 2 choices: (i) necessary cookies only or (ii) accept all non-essential cookies.

s5.heading: 5. Main cookies according to the current platform
s5.i3: enabled only with consent for analysis.
s5.duration: Cookie storage duration is applied per group and/or session, up to the maximum according to the configuration announced at the time of processing.

s6.heading: 6. Legal basis of reference
s6.i1: Law on Personal Data Protection No. 91/2025/QH15 (effective from January 1, 2026).

metadata.description: Refund policy for course purchases at TinyGenius Hub.

refundPolicy.intro: We apply a transparent refund policy to protect parents' rights during the process of using the learning service.

s1.heading: 1. Scope of application
s1.i1: Applies to online course/package purchases on the platform.
s1.i2: Refund refusal cases only apply to the extent permitted by law.

s2.heading: 2. Refund conditions
s2.i1: Requests are submitted within 30 days of the first successful payment.
s2.i2: Request sent from account registered email or verified support channel.
s2.i3: The requested information must be complete to authenticate the transaction.

s5.heading: 5. Processing time
s5.i1: We will respond to the reception status as soon as possible.
s5.i2: Expected processing time is 5–10 working days from receipt of complete valid documents, depending on the payment partner.

s6.heading: 6. Note
s6.i1: This policy does not limit consumers' mandatory rights under the law.
s6.i2: Refunds may be affected by the payment gateway or card issuing bank's policies.
s6.i3: We reserve the right to request additional information to prevent transaction fraud.

s7.heading: 7. Legal basis of reference
